channel.title: Qoax Community Journal
channel.description: Notes from the work of Qoax Community (Коакс Комюнити): events, programmes, and the software we build for public-interest organisations in Bulgaria.

item.title: Atanasoff48: the first 48-hour hackathon at SPGE John Atanasoff
item.dc:creator: Qoax Community
item.description: 62 participants in 16 teams had 48 hours to build a project and present it. Notes on the first edition and what comes next.

item.description: Game jams, a hackathon, a tournament, and an open day between November 2026 and March 2027, with what is confirmed and what is still being decided.

item.title: SUGAMING Jam 2026: three days, seven games
